handbook.territory_release.title: Independent countries by treaty
handbook.territory_release.body: Switch whole, connected populated regions to independence, not annexation. The parent retains land. Treasury and debt are divided by population. One treaty creates one country. Voluntary release renounces the parent's homeland title; compelled release preserves it. A human peace recipient must answer the offer.
Members undertake to defend a member att: Members undertake to defend a member attacked from outside. Admission and grants require unanimity. Civil wars and members' own offensives are not covered.
One country, one vote. Members fund a co: One country, one vote. Members fund a common treasury and vote on admitting partners and grants for members in need. It creates no automatic military obligation.
A light voluntary council. Modest dues,: A light voluntary council. Modest dues, majority voting and a common aid fund, without mutual defence or compulsory political alignment.
Leave the shared collective-defence orga: Leave the shared collective-defence organization first.
Select whole regions for an independent: Select whole regions for an independent settlement.
Only populated regions of that country c: Only populated regions of that country can be released.
Release requires entire regions, not occ: Release requires entire regions, not occupied fragments.
The parent country must retain actual te: The parent country must retain actual territory.
Released regions must form one connected: Released regions must form one connected settlement.
There is no free country identity for th: There is no free country identity for this settlement.
The country's financial accounts are inv: The country's financial accounts are invalid.
Only one independent settlement may be e: Only one independent settlement may be established per deal.
Independence and subjugation cannot be c: Independence and subjugation cannot be combined in one settlement.
Independent settlement: {0}% of the pare: Independent settlement: {0}% of the parent's population and debt. These regions do not become yours.
Release selected whole, connected region: Release selected whole, connected regions instead of transferring them to the partner. The new country receives its population share of treasury and debt. Its identity follows local peoples and the largest region. Voluntary release renounces the parent's homeland title to these original regions. One settlement per deal; the parent must retain land.
Release the selected whole, connected re: Release the selected whole, connected regions as one independent country instead of annexing them. Treasury and debt are divided by population. The parent keeps other land and its homeland claims; independence cannot be combined with subjugation.
Selected regions become independent, not: Selected regions become independent, not your territory. Homeland claims are retained after a compelled release.
An independent country was established i: An independent country was established in {0}
They require an independent country in {: They require an independent country in {0}.
the {0} armed forces were partially demo: the {0} armed forces were partially demobilised
{0} and {1} made peace on no terms at al: {0} and {1} made peace on no terms at all.
The peace offer is awaiting their answer: The peace offer is awaiting their answer.
The offer cannot bypass a human coalitio: The offer cannot bypass a human coalition member or replace a pending offer.
